snippet.title: Black Zen White - Trailer 08 - Short gameplay trailer - Co-op update
snippet.description:
Black Zen White is a puzzle platformer where the world flips every 10 seconds between two versions: black and white. Think, time your moves, bend time, and interact with playful strange creatures in this contemplative, hand-drawn journey inspired by East Asian ink paintings.

Wishlist now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3237030/Black_Zen_White/

Music by Leigh Robinson from Pixabay
